name: Rike + Márcio Reis
description: Rike and Márcio Reis perform a concert followed by a DJ set at Era uma vez em Paris.
longDescription:
Era uma vez em Paris hosts an evening featuring Rike and Márcio Reis on 21 November 2026. The night includes a live concert starting at 22:00, followed by a DJ set at 00:30.

The venue is located at Rua da Galeria de Paris, 106. The event is restricted to guests aged 18 and over.
